title: Palma
description: palmainc.com zoominfo.com/c/palma-inc/344828237 Palma, Inc. is a private, family-owned epoxy flooring manufacturer and installer founded in 1927 in Whippany, New Jersey — now in its third generation (CEO Fred Palma III). It generates estimated annual revenue of $25–42M with only ~10–15 direct employees (heavy use of subcontractors), completing millions of square feet of industrial flooring over 99 years. The company is a rare single-source formulator/applicator — it develops its own products (PalmaLite, PaliKrete, PaliFlake) and installs them, with every square meter personally approved by a family member. Its average project size is $15.3M (Procore data: 122 projects, 76 active simultaneously), serving auto dealerships, jails, hospitals, chemical plants, and government facilities across the U.S. and Canada. Key differentiators: 5-year industry-leading warranty, no membrane required (30–40% cost savings), and full ASTM C722-89 compliance. The company's name — "A Palma, Manton, Palma Co
